name: Resistance Spot Weld
notes: Primary BIW joining. LME risk rises with Zn coating + UHSS (>980 MPa). Use pulsed schedules for UHSS.
source: WorldAutoSteel AHSS Insights, RSW of AHSS

name: Pulsed RSW (multi-pulse schedule)
notes: Mitigates LME in Zn-coated UHSS; broadens current range for DP980/DP1180.

name: RSW + structural adhesive (weld-bond)
notes: Increases stiffness 15–25% and NVH; allows fewer spot welds and/or lighter gauge.

name: Laser beam welding
notes: Enables LWBs and continuous seams. Zn vapour management needed for coated stack.

name: Self-Piercing Rivet
notes: Works steel-to-Al, UHSS+adhesive stacks. Top-sheet hardness limit ~DP1180.

name: Flow-Drill Screw
notes: One-sided access; handles harder top sheets than SPR (e.g. PHS 1500).

name: Clinching
notes: Cheap, coating-tolerant, but limited to softer grades and shear-load joints.

name: Structural adhesive bonding
notes: Usually combined with mechanical joint; crash-grade epoxies needed.
